questions.question: 169 is related to 11 following a certain logic. Following the same logic, 625 is related to 23. To which of the following is 961 related to, following the same logic?
questions.solution:
Logic: [First no.] : [(First no + 2)²]

 
• 
 
For 169:

 
 
• 
 
(11+2)²=13²=169

 
 
 
 
• 
 
For 625:

 
 
• 
 
(23+2)²=25²=625

 
 
 

Applying the logic to 961:

 
• 
 
Let the number be x such that 

 
 
• 
 
(x+2)²=961

 
 
• 
 
x+2=√961

 
 
• 
 
x+2=31

 
 
• 
 
x=31−2

 
 
• 
 
x=29

 

Thus, according to the given logic, 961 is related to 29.

questions.question: In a certain code language, 'TARNISH' is coded as '96' and 'CORRECT' is coded as '89'. How is 'GENERAL' coded in the given language?
questions.solution:
Here, we use the table given below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8fcb728d929365d397103d5cecd9c191afe8549f69a3185a047a1df7afa092c8.png] ​

**Logic: (Sum of the positional value of each alphabet) + Number of alphabets.**

'TARNISH' is coded as '96' →

​⇒ [{T(20) + A(1) + R(18) + N(14) + I(9) + S(19) + H(8)} + 7] = 96

'CORRECT' is coded as '89' →

​⇒ [{C(3) + O(15) + R(18) + R(18) + E(5) + C(3) + T(20)} + 7] = 89

Similarly, 'GENERAL' will be coded as:

​⇒ [{G(7) + E(5) + N(14) + E(5) + R(18) + A(1) + L(12)} + 7] = **69**

Here, 'GENERAL' is coded as **'69'.**

Hence, the correct answer is "Option (1)".

questions.question: If 14 May 1953 is Thursday, then what will be the day of the week on 27 July 1963?
questions.solution:
Given: 14 May 1953 is Thursday.

Now,

14 May 1953 to 14 May 1963 = 10 years (2 leap and 8 ordinary year)

→ In 10 years = (2 × 2) + (8 × 1) = 4 + 8 = 12 days.

And, from 14 May 1963 to 27 July 1963 = 17 (May) + 30(June) + 27(July) = 74 days.

Total odd days = 12 + 74 = 86 days = 86/7 = 12 week and 2 odd days.

So, 27 July 1963 was Thursday + 2 = Saturday.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3"**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

Given:

14 May 1953 = Thursday

As we know:

 
 

 Leap Year
 2 Odd days
 
 

 Normal Year
 1 Odd day
 
 

14 May 1953 = Thursday

14 May 1954 = Thursday + 1 = Friday

14 May 1955 = Friday + 1 = Saturday

14 May 1956 = Saturday + 2 = Monday

14 May 1957 = Monday + 1 = Tuesday

14 May 1958 = Tuesday + 1 = Wednesday

14 May 1959 = Wednesday + 1 = Thursday

14 May 1960 = Thursday + 2 = Saturday

14 May 1961 = Saturday + 1 = Sunday

14 May 1962 = Sunday + 1 = Monday

14 May 1963 = Monday + 1 = Tuesday

Odd days from 14 May 1963 to 27 July 1963 = [May(17) + June (30) + July(27)] = (74 ÷ 7) = 4 Odd days

27 July 1963 = Tuesday + 4 = Saturday

27 July 1963 → Saturday

Hence, the correct answer is "**Option (3)**".

questions.question:
If 'A' stands for '÷', 'B' stands for '×', 'C' stands for '+' and 'D' stands for '-', what will come in place of the question mark '?' in the following equation?

67 C 429 A 11 B 5 D 85 = ?
questions.solution:
Here, we use the table given below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7db1986c0fecbbebe4a0872238cc254f195a803269e810d2c78455359817eb37.png] 

As per the given information:

 
 

 Symbol
 Means
 
 

 A
 ÷
 
 

 B
 ×
 
 

 C
 +
 
 

 D
 -
 
 

Given:

⇒ 67 C 429 A 11 B 5 D 85 =?

Putting sign as per the equation:

⇒ 67 + 429 ÷ 11 × 5 - 85

Apply BODMAS rule:

⇒ 67 + __**429 ÷ 11**__ × 5 - 85

⇒ 67 + __**39 × 5**__ - 85

⇒ 67 + 195 - 85

⇒ 262 - 85 = 177.

Here, the value of the equation is '177'.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option (2)".
